_comment: Starter per-node policy for openclaw-hass-node-assist-tools. Copy this into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json under plugins.entries.openclaw-hass-node-assist-tools.config. Replace <your-node-id> with the paired node's ID (shown in `openclaw nodes status`). See the plugin README for the full config schema.

<your-node-id>._comment: Tier A only — Tier B admin ops disabled. Reads all entities and calendars. Services limited to common household controls.
